description: Reads one thing about a deployed app. manifest: handlers, schema, indexes, endpoints, read metrics. tables: each table with its fields and row count. rows: rows of one table (give table; at most 100 per call, continue with cursor). usage: today's counters and limits. schedules: cron schedules and their last runs. jobs: scheduled jobs. Only the app's owner and workspace admins can inspect.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

cursor.description: For rows: next_cursor from the previous page.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

limit.description: For rows and jobs: most items to return. Default 25.

name: inspect_app
title: Inspect an app
